comment: frFR's texts of Koprulu's own dialogs and records (defs/ui/koprulu-dialogs.json), which the language's data
lack: per dialog, the base's text exactly (the hotkey's byte and colours included) -> the language's. A text
with flag 0x200 keeps an ASCII hotkey: a letter the text highlights, free among its dialog's, as the language's
own dialogs have it. kp_locale.c (native/kp_app) checks each as one of the language's rows and
adds its characters to the glyphs; a text with no entry stays the base's.
